* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009), slip 58: “If opponent just initiated battle, immediately fire a non-lightsaber, non-[Permanent Weapon] weapon present (for free and each weapon destiny is +2). That weapon may fire again this battle.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 5, slip 58. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref> Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-58-Defensive_Fire.png]]) prints slip number “58” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Defensive Fire (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) rewrote the text (“non-Permanent weapon” as published there): “If opponent just initiated battle, you may immediately fire one non-lightsaber, non-Permanent weapon present in that battle once (for free), adding 2 to each of its destiny draws. That weapon may fire again this battle.”<ref name="cl-1220_58-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Defensive Fire (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-D-defensivefire-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual2-Dark">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual2-Dark/large/defensivefire.gif</code>; the Internet Archive capture of that folder's directory listing ([https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034549/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual2-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Virtual2-Dark], 18 August 2019) gives every file the date 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34 (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock2-Dark/large/defensivefire.gif</ref>: “If opponent just initiated battle, immediately fire a non-lightsaber, non-[Permanent Weapon] weapon present (for free and each weapon destiny is +2). That weapon may fire again this battle.” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E1) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 2 set mark) and prints the number “58” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Defensive Fire (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side p. 36), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=36, page 36. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=36 Internet Archive]</ref>: “If opponent just initiated battle, immediately fire a non-lightsaber, non-[Permanent Weapon] weapon present (for free and each weapon destiny is +2). That weapon may fire again this battle.” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image on its page is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1220-58-master.png]]). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number.
